ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.

14. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Sanitation/ PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Foods/Feeding PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Plants ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Animals ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Weather ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Water ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
